title: Documentation placeholder in place of a credential
description: A credential-looking value that a provider's documentation marks as an example, such as YOUR_API_KEY_HERE, appears where a real credential would sit.
semantics: The value was published as illustrative text and was never issued, so it carries no access regardless of the variable name or carrier it appears under.

applicability.rationale: Every provider that documents its credential format publishes placeholder values; the reasoning does not depend on the format.

evidenceBasis.rationale: The ExampleCloud token documentation labels its placeholder text as an example, not an issued key.

sources.supports: Shows exc_live_YOUR_API_KEY_HERE as an example, not an issued key.
